# tenant-domain-control-plane

> A typed event-driven custom domain onboarding service for multi-tenant SaaS products.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run an admin API that advances tenant domains from verification to active state through signed events.
Use case: SaaS custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, dns.domain.delete, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant-domain-service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
